entries.heading: None of the funds made available by this Act may be used
ancestors: DIVISION C—-DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2017
entries.text:
Sec. 8127.  None of the funds made available by this Act may be used 
to carry out the closure or realignment of the United States Naval 
Station, Guantanamo Bay, Cuba.

                      (including transfer of funds)
